records.title: xrRNA-guided Prime Assembly
records.summary: This synthetic bundle contains four typed research objects: a primary symmetric motif panel, a conditional asymmetric-arm assignment, a measurement architecture, and a parked balancing extension. Only the primary object has a dedicated final Idea Report PDF.
records.text: A focused decision portfolio with four separately tracked research objects Genome editing prime editing RNA structure focused decision

records.title: Symmetric structured-RNA motif panel for Prime Assembly
records.summary: A synthetic primary research object that treats paired structured-RNA protection as a state-selective panel rather than a generic stability tag, with explicit measurements and a stopping rule.
records.text: Mechanism-focused PRIMARY REVIEWED Recommended for focused testing The intervention and readout can separate assembly-state protection from bulk abundance. The link between motif symmetry and productive complex residence remains unverified. RNA folding symmetry causal test

records.title: Asymmetric arm assignment
records.summary: A synthetic conditional extension that assigns distinct protective roles to the two RNA arms and remains visible as a separate research object even though it has no dedicated report file.
records.text: Conditional mechanism CONDITIONAL CONDITIONAL Refine before testing It produces a directional prediction that symmetry controls cannot explain. Arm-specific functional exposure has not been established. asymmetry arm assignment conditional

records.title: E_A molecular-identity measurement architecture
records.summary: This synthetic measurement program asks whether the proposed early intermediate can be identified on the same recovered molecule before any mechanistic conclusion is made, without treating the measurement object as a competing biological hypothesis.
records.text: Measurement architecture MEASUREMENT_PROGRAM MEASUREMENT_PROGRAM Measurement-method research It can prevent causal interpretation when the required molecular object is not identifiable. Recovery bias may still decouple the observed molecule from the productive intermediate. molecular identity measurement uncertainty

records.title: QuadPE balancing extension
records.summary: A synthetic parked extension that would balance multiple protected components but is retained only for provenance because it adds complexity before the primary causal gate is resolved.
records.text: System extension EXTENSION PARKED Parked It anticipates stoichiometric imbalance if multiple protected components are later combined. There is no evidence that balancing, rather than the primary gate, is currently limiting. balancing system extension parked

records.summary: The synthetic run preserves a primary target-context gate and a conditional verifier-first contrast as separate reviewed objects. It does not claim that a broad discovery process occurred.
records.text: A focused decision run centered on decision logic and evidence boundaries Cancer immunology PRAME logic gate focused decision

records.title: Target-context gate before transfer
records.summary: A synthetic primary decision object that requires the receiving context to contain and expose the state required by the proposed mechanism before any transfer recommendation is considered.
records.text: Decision gate PRIMARY REVIEWED Refine before testing It turns an implicit transfer assumption into a falsifiable prerequisite. The relevant receiving-context state may not be measurable with sufficient specificity. target context transfer evidence boundary

records.title: Verifier-first contrast
records.summary: A synthetic conditional object that uses state-positive, state-negative, inactive-intervention, and burden-matched contrasts to separate target-state dependence from broad burden.
records.text: Falsification architecture CONDITIONAL CONDITIONAL Refine before testing It can distinguish the intended route from broad burden. The state-positive and state-negative conditions may differ in uncontrolled ways. controls falsification burden

records.summary: A synthetic historical object that treats rotational registry as distinct from linear spacer distance while preserving the evidence gap that prevented architecture-level promotion.
records.text: Historical mechanism ALTERNATIVE PARKED Parked Rotational registry is physically distinct from linear distance. A practical mitochondrial architecture that controls this coordinate was not established. helical phase geometry historical
